Studies of the model system, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), using various routes,… 854417 transgenic-interleukin-10-prevents-induction-of-experimental-autoimmune-encephalomyelitis transgenic interleukin 10 prevents induction experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis The effectiveness of interleukin 10 (IL-10) in the treatment of autoimmune-mediated central nervous system inf Transgenic Interleukin 10 Prevents Induction of Experimental Autoimmune Encephalomyelitis The effectiveness of interleukin 10 (IL-10) in the treatment of autoimmune-mediated central nervous system inflammation is controversial. Studies of the model system, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), using various routes, regimens, and delivery methods of IL-10 suggest that these variables may affect its immunoregulatory function. To study the influence of these factors on IL-10 regulation of EAE pathogenesis, we have analyzed transgenic mice expressing human IL-10 (hIL-10) transgene under the control of a class II major histocompatibility complex (MHC) promoter.
